source_integrity.feature_label_boundary: labels use only raw future OHLC after the current closed bar(현재 종료봉 이후 원천 미래 OHLC만 사용); feature_set_v2 columns are not loaded into label construction(피처 컬럼은 라벨 생성에 로드하지 않음).
source_integrity.leakage_risk: path labels are oracle labels(미래 경로를 아는 라벨) and cannot be interpreted as runtime signals(런타임 신호). current bar high/low is excluded by starting at t+1(현재 봉 고저는 t+1 시작으로 제외).

sample_scope.tier_a: model input rows plus raw US100 OHLC(모델 입력 행 + 원천 US100 OHLC)

source_integrity.split_boundary: train split(학습 분할) only supplies the p90 scale; validation/OOS(검증/표본밖)는 평가 전용입니다.
source_integrity.time_axis: model timestamp(모델 타임스탬프) is matched to raw time_close_unix as broker_clock_close_key(브로커 시계 종가 키); timezone_status remains unresolved, so this is not a direct UTC market-session claim(직접 UTC 세션 주장 아님).
